statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated
Diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9, I47.1 were submitted
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
